cost: $2 per micro RT (same as reused streams)
part_a: avg $/trade, PF, win% by day class (FOMC decision day, CPI, NFP, PPI, JOLTS, GDP, any-event, no-event) for NOISE, CANDACE, late-day; permutation test of mean difference vs non-event days (10000 shuffles). Descriptive only.

part_b_scenarios.APP_INTERNAL: entries blocked [E-15min,E+1min]; open positions flattened at E-2min close (all stages: EVAL, FUNDED, LIVE)
part_b_scenarios.HARD_BREACH_ONLY: firm hard-breach (LIVE): flat from E-1 to E+1: entries blocked [E-1,E+1], positions flattened at E-1 close

part_b_events: sourced events only (dates_us_releases.csv); 10:00 JOLTS+FOMC 14:00 matter inside RTH; ISM/retail sales not sourced (flagged); extra sensitivity APPROX_ISM adds business-day-1 and -3 at 10:00 (unsourced)
part_c_variants: V1 skip NOISE on FOMC decision days
V2 skip NOISE on CPI days
V3 skip NOISE on NFP days
V5 halve NOISE (pnl x0.5) on union(FOMC,CPI,NFP)
V6 halve NOISE on FOMC decision days
part_c_rule: choose on pick = variant with best pick net uplift that is >=0 vs base; pass only if judge net >= base net AND judge PF > base PF AND pick also net>=base AND judge uplift beats 95th pct of random-skip control (same number of days skipped/halved drawn at random from the same window, 5000 draws). 6 variants => expect 0.3 false passes at 5%.
part_d_part2_ideas: pick/judge same discipline; reported in RESULTS.md
